comment: Closed registry of refusal-event kinds (remediation plan Phase 0.1). Every refusal exit in the harness writes exactly one events.jsonl row whose kind is listed here. Additions are data-file diffs visible in git; runtime code never invents a kind. The writer maps any unregistered kind to refusal-unregistered so a refusal signal is never swallowed by a registry gap.

kinds.refusal-dispatch: dispatch_lane.sh fail(): lane dispatch refused before launch
kinds.refusal-phase1-gate: phase1_gate.sh gate G: artifact adequacy gate refused; lanes must not launch
kinds.refusal-promote: promote.sh fail-closed exit: refused control, no verdict rendered
kinds.refusal-endgame: endgame.sh refusal exit: endgame could not complete its judgment
kinds.refusal-unregistered: a refusal path supplied a kind absent from this registry; the attempted kind is recorded in detail
kinds.construction-no-candidate: a host-counted lane dispatch ended without a reviewable candidate (plan 0.4b): itself a NO-relevant signal — it fires the deadline and cannot burn unbounded wall-clock invisible to the instrument; emitted by the 0.4c watchdog/dispatcher
